Trust, Verification & Transparency

Editorial Policy, Primary Sources & GBO Education Disclosure

Direct Answer · Editorial Standards & Publisher Disclosure

GrapesFarming.in is a grower-education publication maintained by Gujarat Bio Organics Pvt. Ltd. (GBO), Bhavnagar, Gujarat. Every rootstock comparison, fertilizer dose, petiole threshold, CIB&RC banned-chemical notice, and APEDA GrapeNet MRL rule is sourced strictly from public Indian agricultural research institutions — never invented MRPs or unverified claims.

Transparent Publisher Disclosure & Separation of Education from Commerce

Who Publishes GrapesFarming.in?

This reference portal is funded and published by Gujarat Bio Organics Pvt. Ltd. (GBO) (Bhavnagar, Gujarat, India) to give Indian vineyard growers fast, outdoor-readable access to peer-reviewed viticulture protocols without paywalls or ad clutter.

Zero Invented Numbers & Neutral Biostimulant Policy

We never fabricate live mandi prices, fertilizer MRPs, or unverified yield promises. Where biostimulants (seaweed/humic acids) are discussed, they are framed neutrally alongside NPK and water chemistry — explicitly noting they cannot substitute for 110R rootstock or bicarbonate acidification.

Fact-Checking, Calculator Audit & Compliance Rules

  • Two Strictly Separated Fertilizer Regimes: Maharashtra/Karnataka single-crop drip (ICAR-NRCG Pune) and Tamil Nadu double-crop Bower (TNAU Agritech) are never blended. Both Worked Examples (a) and (b) are verified by automated unit tests on every build.
  • Safety-First Chemical Compliance: CIB&RC banned chemicals (Dichlorvos, Monocrotophos, Carbofuran, Phorate), Streptocycline antibiotic restrictions, CPPU ≤ 2 ppm caps, Tank A/B Ca(NO₃)₂ isolation, and ICAR-NRCG Annexure-5 EU MRL PHIs are prominently preserved across every relevant guide.
  • Regional Land Unit Accuracy: Acre (40 Gunthas = 4,046.86 m²), Saurashtra/GJ/Gaekwad Vighas (16/20/24 Gunthas), HP Bigha (800 m²), and J&K Kanal (505.86 m²) follow Revenue Department 2026 standards.
  • Update Cadence: Content is reviewed against annual ICAR-NRCG Annexure-5 RMP circulars and APEDA GrapeNet advisories. Last full technical review: 2026-11-25.
